svg.title: Conversation flow through the agent stack
svg.desc: Flowchart showing a customer message moving from channel through Voiceflow intent detection, n8n action execution, and either resolution or human handoff.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What channels should we support first for our customer support agent?')
sendPrompt('How does Voiceflow detect intent and extract entities from a message?')
sendPrompt('How does Voiceflow perform a RAG lookup against a knowledge base?')
sendPrompt('How does Voiceflow decide if a query needs an API action vs a simple answer?')
sendPrompt('What kinds of questions can the agent answer directly without an API call?')
sendPrompt('What does a clean direct answer response look like from the agent?')
sendPrompt('What kinds of actions does n8n execute on behalf of the agent?')
sendPrompt('Give me examples of n8n workflows for customer support actions')
sendPrompt('How does n8n return action results back to Voiceflow for a reply?')
sendPrompt('What triggers escalation to a human agent in Voiceflow?')
sendPrompt('How do we structure the human handoff summary sent via Slack or email?')
g.text: Slack / email alert with context summary

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do we log resolved conversations back to improve the knowledge base?')
